text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am explaining training methods
aimed at the "Twinkle Star Climax" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>,
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If there's one thing I'd like to ask about training for the "Twinkle Star Climax"—
choice_data_list: About the Umamusume of the Year...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
About the training goals for the
"TS Climax," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: From now on, Trainer, you will be guiding your trainee with the goal of qualifying for the "TS Climax."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: First, enter races to collect Performance Points based on your results, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"There is a required amount of Performance Pt
set for each tier, such as Junior Class
and Classic Class."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please take note: if you fail to gather the required
'Performance Pts' by the end of late December each year,
your training will come to an end!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You earn more Performance Pt by achieving
better results in higher-grade races."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Also, it seems formidable rival Umamusume may sometimes enter the races as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Formidable foes will appear as "Rivals"
on the race registration screen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you triumph over your rivals in races, you can earn Skill Hints, so be sure to proactively challenge them!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, unlike previous training scenarios,
there are no individual goals for each Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So, we can also challenge various races that we couldn't run in until now!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please be sure to choose races
that suit your trainee yourself, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During the training period, you might get to catch
a new glimpse into the daily lives of the academy's Umamusume.
That's something to look forward to as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of
the "TS Climax" training goals.
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the "TS Climax," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Collect "Record Points" in each training period,
and if you meet the target for all of them,
you can challenge the "TS Climax."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "TS Climax" is a special series
of three races for the Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "You'll earn 'Victory Pt' based on your finishing position in each race, and the Umamusume with the highest total points across all 3 races wins♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The competing Umamusume will be the same
across all three races, but they'll become
tougher and tougher as the matches progress.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Train your Umamusume well before
the "TS Climax" and seize the title
of "Twinkle Top Star"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of
the "TS Climax."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
About the Special Shop during
"TS Climax" training, right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During training, entering races will award you
"Shop Coins" in addition to "Result Pts"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You earn more Shop Coins the higher you place in races,
and you can spend them in the Special Shop♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the "Special Shop,"
you can exchange for "Training Items" to assist in raising Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Items that boost basic stats, restore energy, and enhance training effects will be available to help with your training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please make proactive use of the "Special Shop"
to raise your Umamusume to their fullest potential♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that the Special Shop will become available
after the Junior-class Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, each training item
will be replaced with new training items
after a certain amount of time has passed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you find training items you want, we recommend
gathering Shop Coins and exchanging for them
before the lineup changes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, when training items are restocked,
a random sale may occasionally occur,
allowing you to exchange for items at a lower cost!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, it seems training items may
sometimes be added after a race concludes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Be sure to check the Special Shop regularly♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of the
Special Shop during "TS Climax" training.
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the "Best Umamusume" award, right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "Best Umamusume" is an award
judged by the URA for each division—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It is an immense honor, with awards given to the Umamusume who were the most successful that year across the Junior, Classic, and Senior Classes!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
At the end of every December, once the year's final
race concludes, the selection for the
'Umamusume of the Year' takes place.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "Best Umamusume" is chosen based on various criteria,
such as race records and fan numbers
throughout that year♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Make good use of training and training items to raise your Umamusume and challenge plenty of races!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
of the "Best Umamusume" award.
Do you have any other questions?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
